castle.description: A fortress of stone and shadow.

hollow_depths.description: Empty void where light struggles to exist. Recovery through connection.

missions.description: Collect coins and reach the exit.
Scout the forest perimeter and eliminate basic threats.
Explore the ancient clearing and retrieve the sacred relic.
Navigate the treant's territory and activate ancient switches.
Race through the forest before time runs out!
Explore every corner of the hidden grove.
Protect the market from bandits!
Chase the thief across the rooftops!
Navigate the dark tunnels beneath the town.
Climb the bell tower and ring the alarm.
Confront the corrupt mayor and his guards.
Set off fireworks for the festival celebration!
Descend into the crystal caverns.
Navigate across the underground river.
Climb the treacherous vertical shafts.
Face the Crystal Golem in its domain.
Find all the hidden treasure in the caves.
Breach the castle's outer defenses.
Storm the castle towers.
Fight through to the throne room.
Duel the Dark Knight in single combat.
Raid the castle treasury!
Complete the king's ultimate challenge!
Navigate the poison-filled sewers.
Face the Plague Rat King and his swarm!
Uncover the ancient secrets beneath the castle.
Wake up alone in the darkness. Find a way forward.
Climb through the emptiness. You're not alone in this.
Navigate the depths with newfound support. Recovery isn't linear.
Ascend from the Hollow Depths. The hub awaits, changed but hopeful.
A stranger offers guidance through the Veiled Vale. Her voice is warm. Her eyes are careful.
Samson challenges Aen to a training bout. The body remembers what the mind tries to forget.
Aen hears Samson's echo more clearly. A Guilt Wraith has taken Samson's voice to taunt him.
Full reunion. Samson fights at Aen's side through an optional co-op trial.
Sophia needs old map shards from the pre-corruption paths. They hold routes the current maps refuse to show.
Whispers about Sophia spread through the hub. Aen hears the rumours from minor NPCs. Then Sophia says goodbye.

objectives.description: Speak with Sophia before she leaves

missions.description: Sophia returns as a traveller. She needs Star Ink from a rare high-altitude location to finish a map for Aen.
Marcel needs the forge defended while he gathers materials. Hold the line against incoming waves.
Aen finds a broken hammer bearing Marcel's sigil. Retrieving its fragments leads through a dangerous side path.
Marcel has joined the Ember Monastery as a smith. He needs rare Hearthstone ore from a deep side-level to finish Aen's blade.
Hazel weaves lantern cloth but needs soft materials — silk-thread moss and cloud reed from low-threat creatures and plants.
A torn piece of Hazel's lantern cloth has appeared deep in the Hollow Depths. Retrieving it leads through a dangerous zone.
Hazel is finishing the Beacon Lantern in the Ember Monastery. One rare material remains — woven-root, from a high-skill challenge area.
